meta.title: The Tern Isles
meta.premise: A new trainer leaves Tern Harbour with a first Pokemon, to earn the badges of the isles.
meta.backdrop: Small green islands lie in a warm sea, and ferries join them. People live, work and battle beside Pokemon. Every island has a Pokemon Center, a shop and a gym.
meta.scope: Play runs island by island, and no ending is written for it.

harbour-road.name: The Harbour Road
harbour-road.brief: A grassy road above the ferry dock
harbour-road.description: Tall grass grows beside a road that runs above the ferry dock.

tern-harbour.name: Tern Harbour
tern-harbour.description: A small town gathers around a ferry dock and a shop.

pokemon-center.name: The Pokemon Center
pokemon-center.brief: The healing house by the dock
pokemon-center.description: A calm building where Nurse Wren heals every Pokemon for free.

tern-gym.name: Tern Gym
tern-gym.description: A stone gym that opens its door at the evening tide.

gull-cove.name: Gull Cove
gull-cove.brief: A rocky cove past the tree line
gull-cove.description: A rocky cove where the waves break on dark stones.

mira.name: Professor Mira
mira.brief: The professor who gave the player a first Pokemon.

rook.name: Rook
